name: Arena Battles: A HoMM3 Fan Mod
description: Arena battles only: pick a hero, skills, artifacts, spells and army, then fight the computer (PvE) or a friend on the same computer (PvP). Custom Arena sets up any battle by hand.
author: Tihomir Ivanov (TishGamer)

0.1.0: Main menu: title, New Arena Battle, Credits, Quit
0.5.0: Renamed from VCMI Arena to Arena Battles (mod id arenabattles)
0.6.0: Skill draft: fill the 8 skill slots with battle skills only (1 of 3 per screen)
Level-ups to 25 are automatic, all skills reach Expert
0.7.0: Hero choice: 4 heroes (2 might, 2 magic) from 4 different factions, name shown on top
Heroes with non-battle specialties (gold, resources, Navigation, Logistics, Eagle Eye, First Aid, Ballista, ...) are no longer offered
Earthquake removed from the spell draft (the arena has no walls)
Artifacts are drafted slot by slot (helmet, necklace, cloak, weapon, shield, armor, boots, 2 rings, 2 misc); drafted parts form combination artifacts automatically; Orb of Inhibition removed
Armies 10x larger, like the end of a large map; every creature offer has the same total strength (upgraded and stronger creatures come in smaller stacks), no random amounts
Every creature step offers one creature of the hero's faction and two of other factions
